coverage_notes.ocha_result: No new in-window OCHA OPT operational update surfaced; the freshest targeted result remained the 18 September 2026 Humanitarian Situation Report.
coverage_notes.who_result: No new in-window WHO Gaza operational update surfaced.
coverage_notes.additional_coverage: Exactly 12 targeted searches covered Reuters/AP civilian casualties and military operations, WAFA, UNRWA, Palestine Red Crescent, UNICEF, WFP, ICRC, crossings and aid/fuel/medical evacuation, ceasefire/hostages/detention, hospital functioning capacity, and infrastructure/water/food/displacement.
coverage_notes.exclusions: A Reuters Connect funeral video concerning the already-known Khan Younis strike was treated as recycled follow-up without a new operational development. Older, non-Gaza, duplicate, opinion, unsupported social, and unsourced material were excluded.
